algorithm.counting: Count every actual objective evaluation, including repeated grid centers
algorithm.endpoint_fits: Independent Control and2%SDP endpoint fits; equal animal weights
algorithm.objective: Mean of per-animal means of squared normalized AREA residuals
algorithm.order: Rate outer ascending; lag inner ascending, at every stage
algorithm.outside_bounds: Skip outside inclusive bounds; never clip or rescale observations
algorithm.refinement_center: Previous stage best; fixed throughout the next complete stage
algorithm.selection: Lexicographic minimum of (objective,rate,lag), no tolerance or early stop

limitations: Six calibration animals with repeated observations are not54independent animals.
Four cohort parameters; no identified causal drug/substrate mechanism.
Dose interpolation is empirical; treatment effect need not be monotone.
No cell-layer, chemical injury, barrier or clinical validation.
Heldout animals and independent studies require separate frozen evaluation.

provenance.care: 7mm nominal mechanical debridement; PBS/SDP200uL plus moxifloxacin every6h
provenance.normalization: Within each actual rabbit baseline raw image area; original area unit unspecified
provenance.publication: Abdel-Naby et al.2017; DOI10.1371/journal.pone.0188154; S1Fig2 workbook
